scope: descriptive only; target label was dropped before analysis and never inspected

not_selected.music amount: caption tags and VAD do not quantify music reliably
not_selected.cutting pace: 20 sparse frames miss cuts and confound change with sample spacing
not_selected.single-scene: zero threshold crossings among sparse frames does not establish one scene
not_selected.audio quality score: eGeMAPS describes mixed speech/music/ambience, not recording quality
not_selected.label association scans: feature selection on the full dataset would contaminate evaluation; use training data only

known_measurement_limits.pauses: VAD can classify music as voice; interpret as VAD silence, especially for Shorts
known_measurement_limits.speaking_rate: cleaned transcript words per video minute; edited speech density, not articulation rate
known_measurement_limits.thumbnail_crop: column-variance heuristic, not a verified pillarbox detector
known_measurement_limits.faces: OpenCV Haar detections, not identity, gaze, or composition ground truth
